description: Single storey outbuilding in rear garden including canopy and boiler room; raised patio at rear (retrospective)
decision_conditions:
<div style="line-height: 20px;">The canopy, by reason of its excessive, additional depth beyond the 6m rear extension, would result in an unduly dominant and overbearing form of development. Furthermore, Its scale and projection would unacceptably impact the amenity of the neighbouring property, specifically No. 22 Clifton Road, causing harm to outlook and creating a sense of enclosure. As such, the proposal fails to respect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and is therefore contrary to <span style="text-align: justify;">National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core
Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary
Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and policy GR1 of the emerging Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span></div><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:
